evidence.quote: I check, the dealer checks behind me, and we go to showdown.
My J♥ 10♠ with the board makes an 8-to-Queen straight

criteria.why: Replies are short, plain table talk with no JSON or tool talk. The one slip is Turn 4, where the dealer speaks as the player ('I check', 'My J♥ 10♠').

evidence.quote: You call the 10 to match the dealer's big blind.
You bet 50 and the dealer calls, so the pot is 140.
You raise to 100 and the dealer calls.

criteria.why: Every reply acts on the player's latest message or click: the bet, call, check, raise, fold and Deal again are each carried out.

evidence.quote: The dealer's K♣ 4♦ is a King-high hand.
so I win the 140 pot. Net +70, bankroll 1,070.
New hand. You're in the small blind again

criteria.why: The Croupier deals streets, plays the dealer's actions, reveals the hand at showdown and settles the pot itself. It uses the bet sizes the player chose.

evidence.quote: New hand. You're in the small blind again, bankroll 1,070.
You raise to 100 and the dealer calls. The pot is 200 and your bankroll is 960.

criteria.why: The showdown, pot and bankroll math match the surface and earlier replies. A minor slip: new-hand replies quote the bankroll before the blind (1,070, 1,060) while the surface shows it after (1,060, 1,050).
